name: System
command: export LC_ALL=C; load=$(sysctl -n vm.loadavg | awk '{print $2}'); boot=$(sysctl -n kern.boottime | sed -E 's/^\{ sec = ([0-9]+).*/\1/'); up=$(( $(date +%s) - boot )); ncpu=$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu); st=$(awk -v l="$load" -v n="$ncpu" 'BEGIN{print (l>n)?"warn":"ok"}'); rows=$(ps -Arco pcpu=,comm= | head -5 | awk '{c=$1; $1=""; sub(/^ +/,""); gsub(/["\\]/,""); printf "%s{\"title\":\"%s\",\"value\":\"%s%%\",\"icon\":\"sf:cpu\"}", (NR>1?",":""), $0, c}'); printf '{"items":[{"type":"stat","label":"Load (1m)","value":%s,"decimals":2},{"type":"stat","label":"Uptime","value":%d,"format":"duration"},{"type":"status","label":"CPU load","state":"%s","detail":"%s cores"},{"type":"list","label":"Top CPU","rows":[%s]}]}\n' "$load" "$up" "$st" "$ncpu" "$rows"
